title: Private-sector workers protest against removal of budget relief allowance
location: In front of Ministry of Labour, Narahenpita, Colombo
organizer: Private Sector Employees’ Centre and Workers’ Struggle Centre
threshold_50_evidence: Daily Mirror confirms an executed protest but gives no headcount; threshold >=50 is unresolved.

occurrence.summary: Daily Mirror reports the two worker groups staged a protest on 2 July.

date.summary: Publication dated 3 July identifies the protest date as 2 July 2025.

location.summary: In front of Ministry of Labour in Narahenpita, Colombo.

threshold.summary: Count absent; whether 50 or more were simultaneously present is unknown.

state_target.summary: Protest occurred outside Labour Ministry and demanded withdrawal of a proposed bill affecting private-sector relief allowance.

demands.summary: Withdrawal of proposed bill eliminating Rs. 2,500 budget relief allowance, plus other demands; coded labor_wage_dispute.

state_response.summary: Police or government response at the protest is not described; all dimensions unknown.

notes: A reported executed protest, not verified to threshold.
open_questions: Find local follow-up with crowd estimate and whether government addressed or changed the bill.

title: Jaffna landowners protest military control of ancestral lands
threshold_50_evidence: The source describes demonstrators and placards but gives no count; threshold unresolved.

occurrence.summary: Tamil Guardian describes an executed demonstration by Valikamam landowners earlier in the week of 14 July.

date.summary: Story dated 18 July says earlier that week; exact day unknown.

state_target.summary: Demonstrators targeted the Presidential Secretariat, asking for return of ancestral lands held by Sri Lankan military.

demands.summary: Return of ancestral lands; coded land_farm_issue.

state_response.summary: Police presence was reported; outcomes across response dimensions remain unknown.

notes: Start day is imprecise: the body says earlier in the week of 18 July; no exact day assigned.
open_questions: Find an independent local report or participant estimate; verify exact protest day and any state response.
